summary: DoRaa Sangam House is a luxury-themed e-commerce single-page application built with React + TypeScript (TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui) and backed by an Internet Computer (Motoko) canister. The storefront supports browsing a canister-backed product catalog (collections and category overlays), viewing rich product details (shareable /product/:id routes with dynamic SEO metadata), wishlist and cart (localStorage), and checkout via Razorpay (test mode) followed by on-chain order creation. Users authenticate via a hybrid model: a simulated OTP session for storefront gating plus Internet Identity for authenticated canister calls (profile, orders, admin). A separate admin panel (Internet Identity + frontend guard + backend RBAC) supports product catalog management (CRUD, image upload UI, and bulk upload from CSV/ZIP). The app includes PWA support (manifest + service worker), premium toast styling, notifications bell UI, reduced-motion accessibility, and multiple ambient/cinematic background effects.

existing_features.title: Centralized brand identity constants
existing_features.description: Exports consistent brand name and generated asset paths (logo mark, favicon, bot avatar) for use across the storefront and admin UI.

existing_features.title: Dark luxury theme, premium UI utilities, and reduced-motion support
existing_features.description: Implements a premium dark theme via CSS variables mapped into Tailwind and a rich set of interaction utilities (glows, shimmer skeletons, ripples, reveal animations) with prefers-reduced-motion fallbacks.

existing_features.title: Custom SPA routing without React Router
existing_features.description: Provides minimal client-side routing using history.pushState/popstate plus a custom navigation event so all hook instances remain synchronized across the app.

existing_features.title: Ambient cinematic background rendering
existing_features.description: Renders high-production canvas-based ambience layers (ocean waves/foam/sand shimmer and pearl shimmer ambience) with performance-conscious refs/caching and reduced-motion static fallbacks.

existing_features.title: Cinematic hero slider with gesture support
existing_features.description: Full-screen hero carousel with autoplay, pause-on-interaction, pointer/touch swipe gestures, arrow/dot navigation, layered parallax visuals, and reduced-motion-aware transitions.

existing_features.title: Typography micro-animations
existing_features.description: Animated per-letter reveal for headlines and a per-letter roller/flip tagline interaction, both respecting reduced-motion preferences.

existing_features.title: Scroll reveal and staggered reveal system
existing_features.description: IntersectionObserver-based reveal utilities for sections/cards with configurable thresholds/margins and stagger behavior; reveals immediately for reduced-motion users.

existing_features.title: Infinite scroll helper hook
existing_features.description: Reusable sentinel-based infinite loading trigger with hasMore/isLoading guards and configurable threshold/rootMargin.

existing_features.title: Internet Identity authentication context
existing_features.description: Initializes/restores AuthClient identities, provides login/logout and status flags, and surfaces errors (with benign “already authenticated” suppressed by AuthErrorAlert).

existing_features.title: Canister actor creation bound to identity with RBAC initialization

existing_features.title: Motoko RBAC authorization layer
existing_features.description: Role assignment and permission checks inside the canister: initialization assigns #admin (token match) or #user; exposes role queries, admin checks, and admin-only role assignment.

existing_features.title: Motoko product catalog APIs (public listing + admin CRUD + bulk import)
existing_features.description: Stores products in canister memory and exposes public product listing plus admin-only catalog CRUD and bulk import endpoints.

existing_features.title: Motoko order APIs
existing_features.description: Allows authenticated users to create orders (paid status) and retrieve their order history, including a year/month filter endpoint.

existing_features.title: Motoko user profile APIs
existing_features.description: Stores user profile data keyed by principal; users can get/save their own profile, and admins can query other users’ profiles.

existing_features.title: Storefront product catalog queries with backend-to-storefront mapping
existing_features.description: Loads the catalog from the canister via React Query, converts backend products into StorefrontProduct shape (colors/sizes from variants, images, numeric price), supports category filtering and per-product lookup, and uses toast-based error handling.

existing_features.title: Collections page with category showcase, filtering overlays, and empty states
existing_features.description: Renders a responsive product grid with infinite scroll, a category carousel overlay for Banarasi collections, and premium empty states when no products exist.

existing_features.title: Premium product cards with wishlist/cart actions and quick-details overlay
existing_features.description: Myntra/Flipkart-style product cards with luxury hover effects, deterministic discount formatting, wishlist and cart actions with auth gating, add-to-cart animation and ripple feedback, and a quick details overlay on desktop hover.

existing_features.title: Wishlist management (localStorage)

existing_features.title: Quick view product sheet

existing_features.title: Product detail route with zoom gallery and dynamic metadata
existing_features.description: Dedicated shareable product route that renders a full product detail view with multi-image zoom/pan gallery, rich attributes, cart/wishlist actions, scroll locking, and SEO metadata updates (title/description/OG/Twitter/canonical).

existing_features.description: Dynamically sets and restores document.title, meta description, Open Graph tags, Twitter Card tags, and canonical URL; creates missing tags and cleans up on unmount.

existing_features.title: Cart state management with persistence and cart UI sheets
existing_features.description: Implements cart add/update/remove/clear operations persisted in localStorage and provides a right-side cart sheet UI with quantity controls, removal, subtotal display, and checkout entry.

existing_features.title: Checkout flow with Razorpay test-mode payment and backend order creation
existing_features.description: Collects contact/shipping details, initiates Razorpay Checkout (test mode), then creates an order in the canister and clears the cart on success; shows an order-confirmation screen with the order ID.

existing_features.title: Order history UI with year/month filtering and details dialog
existing_features.description: Fetches orders for the authenticated user and displays them with a year/month filter selector and a details dialog showing shipping and payment info.

existing_features.title: Storefront authentication with simulated OTP + WebOTP assistance + lockout
existing_features.description: Implements a simulated phone OTP flow with 2-minute expiry, optional WebOTP auto-read, manual-entry assistance modal, 3-attempt lockout with countdown, flash messages, and return-path handling for protected routes/actions.

existing_features.title: Protected routes and auth redirect utilities
existing_features.description: Guards protected pages and actions by redirecting unauthenticated users to /login?tab=signin while storing a return path and a deduplicated flash message.

existing_features.title: User dashboard profile persistence with backend-first and localStorage fallback
existing_features.description: Loads/saves user profile data via the canister when authenticated (Internet Identity), falling back to localStorage when backend calls fail or the user is unauthenticated.

existing_features.title: Profile and address input sanitization/validation with premium error toasts
existing_features.description: Sanitizes and validates profile and address form fields (name and phone), blocks saving when invalid, and displays premium-styled error toasts explaining validation failures.

existing_features.title: Premium toast system for common storefront errors
existing_features.description: Provides premium-styled top-right toasts (gold border, luxury dark background, pearl off-white text, timed fade) used across OTP failures, save failures, duplicates, and network errors.

existing_features.title: Notification bell system with unread glow and action-triggered alerts
existing_features.description: Adds an authenticated-only notification bell in the header with unread counter and glow; supports a simple notification list and triggers messages for key actions (Profile updated, Added to cart, Order placed), marking notifications read when opened.

existing_features.title: International phone input with country detection and validation
existing_features.description: Compact country selector with search, locale/timezone-based default country detection, country-specific digit rules, and E.164 formatting for OTP session creation.

existing_features.title: Admin panel with protected routing, layout, and catalog management
existing_features.description: Admin area protected by Internet Identity and a principal-based frontend guard; includes layout with principal display and logout, dashboard metrics UI, products listing with skeleton/error states, create/edit forms with validation, and delete confirmations; syncs updates to storefront by invalidating product queries.

existing_features.title: Admin bulk upload from CSV/ZIP with client parsing and backend import
existing_features.description: Validates and parses CSV (or extracts CSV from ZIP), converts rows to product form data, uploads via adminBulkImportProducts, shows progress UI and success/error toasts, and navigates back to the products list.

existing_features.title: Admin product form with multi-image dropzone and variant generation inputs
existing_features.description: Admin UI for creating/editing products including required validation, 5–10 image dropzone with previews/removal, fabric presets/custom fabric input, multi-select colors and sizes, blouse pairing field, and category selection.

existing_features.title: Admin save feedback and return highlight animation
existing_features.description: Shows toast feedback and temporarily highlights the saved product in the admin list after returning from create/edit, with reduced-motion-aware animation classes.

existing_features.title: PWA support with service worker app-shell caching
existing_features.description: Adds an installable PWA experience with a web app manifest, a service worker that caches core static assets for offline app-shell loading, and runtime fetch caching for same-origin static content (skipping canister/external calls).

existing_features.title: Static SEO root files
existing_features.description: Provides robots.txt that allows storefront and blocks admin/dashboard/login, plus a sitemap.xml listing indexable storefront URLs.

existing_features.title: Rule-based RaaHi assistant chat widget
existing_features.description: Floating assistant widget with session-based auto-greeting, typing simulation, message history, and keyword-based canned responses (no external LLM).

existing_features.title: Inactivity-based auto-logout
existing_features.description: Optionally logs users out after 30 minutes of inactivity by monitoring common interaction events and triggering a centralized logout flow with a flash message.

existing_features.title: Canister HTTP outcalls helper module
existing_features.description: Provides reusable Motoko helpers for HTTP GET/POST outcalls via the IC management canister, including a response transform that strips headers and cycle budgeting defaults.

existing_features.title: Implement a “full clean boot” reset flow that wipes all client-side persisted state (auth session, cart, wishlist, and any related local/session storage used by storefront auth) and returns the app to a clean first-run state.

Add an explicit emergency reset entry point that a user can trigger even when the app is in a broken auth/routing state (e.g., a dedicated route like /reset or a /login query flag) which executes the full clean boot reset and then navigates to the Sign In view.

Fix the post-login redirect behavior so that successful login (OTP flow and Internet Identity flow) navigates to /dashboard (or to a stored return path if it exists and is safe), and ensure the redirect happens consistently without a blank screen on first load.

Resolve the dashboard route first-load crash by making /dashboard render safely when auth state is restoring and when backend/query dependencies are not yet ready; show a non-blank loading or fallback UI instead of rendering nothing or crashing.
Ensure the reset flow also clears any in-memory caches that can preserve broken state across navigation (including React Query cache) and then forces a clean navigation to the login screen.

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix blank screen immediately after login by resolving dashboard route crash and ensuring auth state restores/redirects to /dashboard reliably.
Add a full clean-boot reset flow that wipes all local client data (auth session, cart, wishlist, etc.) to recover from broken auth/routing states.

architectural_notes: Custom lightweight SPA routing via History API (useSpaLocation) instead of React Router.
TanStack React Query is used for canister data access (queries/mutations) and cache invalidation on identity/actor changes.
Context providers split client state by domain: CommerceProvider (cart), NotificationsProvider (notification bell), AdminProductsProvider (admin catalog).
Hybrid authentication model: simulated OTP session for storefront access plus Internet Identity (AuthClient) for canister identity/privileged actions.
Motoko backend uses a modular RBAC layer (AccessControl + MixinAuthorization) and traps unauthorized calls server-side.
Frontend uses explicit mapping layers between admin form models, backend canister types, and storefront view models.
SEO is handled via a custom hook that updates/restores document title, meta description, OpenGraph/Twitter tags, and canonical links on mount/unmount.
PWA app-shell caching is implemented via a simple service worker that intentionally skips caching canister and external API calls.
UI/animation system is built around a dark “luxury” theme with extensive Tailwind utilities and prefers-reduced-motion fallbacks.
Checkout integrates an external payment UI (Razorpay) client-side and then persists orders server-side via canister calls.
known_issues: Frontend admin access is gated by a hardcoded ADMIN_PRINCIPAL set to the anonymous principal ("2vxsx-fae"), which prevents real admin principals from accessing the admin panel even if backend RBAC grants admin.

Cart totals are computed from a legacy localStorage product catalog key ("doraa-admin-products") rather than the React Query canister product list; totals may be wrong/zero if that cache is absent or stale.
Backend Order.createOrderRecord uses a fixed timestamp constant, so all orders share the same timestamp.
Backend getUserOrdersByYearMonth compares epoch-millisecond timestamps against YYYYMMDD-style numeric ranges, so date filtering is incorrect.
AdminProductsProvider.createProduct refreshes products then searches for the new item using a potentially stale captured `products` array; it may fail to find the created product.
Storefront product conversion assigns randomized rating/reviewCount on each fetch, leading to inconsistent values across refreshes.
ZIP CSV extraction is intentionally simplified (assumes uncompressed local file entries); many real ZIP archives will fail to parse.
RBAC initialization traps if CAFFEINE_ADMIN_TOKEN is not set in the canister environment; misconfigured deployments will break privileged flows.

AccessControl.getUserRole traps with "User is not registered" for principals that have not been initialized/registered, which may cause unexpected failures for authenticated users until initialization runs.
useRegisterUser() is a stub (no backend call), so explicit user registration is not implemented.
